Join the thousands of responders using Beacon  worldwide.

Beacon is used by ambulance services, fire departments, disaster response and search and rescue teams to coordinate response operations in more than 20 countries.

Beacon is used by alternative response networks to coordinate community responders during mental health emergencies, domestic violence crises, substance abuse overdoses and gang-related violence.

Beacon was designed to be a flexible solution to streamline dispatch operations in any environment. Whether you utilize a traditional CAD system, have a more modern structure that you would like to increase efficiencies, or are starting from scratch and need to build out your dispatch infrastructure entirely, Beacon’s cloud-based platform and 24/7 support provides solutions for today’s readily-available mobile technologies.

Create Free Agency Account

Sign Up as a dispatcher to create an Agency Account on the Beacon platform.

2

AddResponders

Create responders in the web application and have them easily respond to incidents.

3

Download Mobile App

After setting up your dispatcher account, invite responders to download and install the Beacon mobile app on their devices.

** Software minimum compatibility requirement of iOS 16 or Android 7 in order to run the latest version of Beacon.

Create Incidents & Respond
